forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain nonempty frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Every receipt/checkpoint must bind the actual frozen DESIRED_STATE parsed control_revision plus Git blob SHA and the actual frozen evaluation config parsed config_revision plus Git blob SHA. If a claimed revision/blob does not equal the exact frozen file or either identity is unverifiable, set bootstrap_valid=false and treat the run as diagnostic-only; it cannot count as positive Phase-1/parity evidence.
policy.control_freshness: Obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. At H1 fetch sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config, parse their revisions, and freeze both path/revision/blob identities. Repeat SHA-only head lookup before the first substantive semantic read; if either authoritative identity changed, restart bootstrap. The first own-state/public-source semantic read is the semantic-freeze barrier. AFTER THAT BARRIER DO NOT POLL OR COMPARE GENERIC MAIN HEAD BEFORE checker-v2 authoring, durable precommit/readback, checker persistence/readback, and the precommitted control executions. Generic main movement caused by concurrent workers is not a work-termination signal. Complete that bounded evaluation work under the frozen authority tuple and consume no newer-head semantic content. Immediately before any current-Phase-1 positive acceptance/worker_pass/root-acceptance claim, perform one exact identity-only revalidation of DESIRED_STATE and automation_control/roles/evaluation.json. If both blobs still equal the frozen identities and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists, mark acceptance_authority_current=true. If either changed or is unverifiable, preserve the role-local artifacts as diagnostic evidence under the frozen tuple, set acceptance_authority_current=false/bootstrap_valid=false for current acceptance use, checkpoint exact continuation, and fresh-bootstrap next invocation; do not discard completed checker/control work and do not adopt newer semantics mid-run.

postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.acceptance_revalidation_barrier: Immediately before any positive Phase-1/worker/root acceptance claim, verify only the two frozen path-to-blob identities using SHA/path/blob-only transport.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.allowed_after_freeze: role-local/public semantic work under the frozen tuple; role-local current-blob/CAS/readback writes; one identity-only authority revalidation at the acceptance-publication barrier
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.forbidden_after_freeze: generic head-drift polling as a termination gate before checker/control completion; newer-head authority file bodies or semantics; commit messages/diffs; other-role configs/receipts/state; O/downstream semantics
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.acceptance_current_when: both frozen authority blobs are unchanged at the publication barrier and no own-state CAS/input conflict requires reconstruction
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.diagnostic_only_when: either authority identity is mismatched or unverifiable at publication barrier, receipt provenance does not match the frozen files, checker precommit order is violated, or own-state conflict makes the claimed execution lineage ambiguous

required_order: freeze exact root/config tuple and validate bootstrap
durably precommit checker identity plus Control A/B/C oracles and exact-readback
first checker execution on precommitted controls
only then emit any current positive acceptance claim
checker_v2_execution_order_contract.self_or_other_worker_main_writes_do_not_: Only exact root/config identity change at acceptance revalidation can make the completed run ineligible for current positive acceptance; generic main drift alone cannot terminate bounded checker work.

policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Discover connector/tool/schema capability only through non-mutating schema/list/discovery and read-only lookup. Never create/update/delete/move a branch, ref, file, PR, issue, release, workflow or external resource as a noop/test/probe. A connector mutation is allowed only when required by substantive evaluation work and confined to the authorized evaluation state/output or own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.repository_write_boundary: Authorized writes are confined to research_workers_clean_g1/evaluation/ role-local state/output pointers and automation_control/receipts/evaluation/ immutable receipts. Temporary/noop branches or refs and mutations outside those destinations are forbidden.

migration.reason: The first durable execution under DESIRED_STATE control22/evaluation config7 again stopped solely because generic note-main SHA changed after semantic freeze, before checker-v2 authoring/execution, despite config7 already declaring main_sha_drift_alone_is_stop=false. Repeated unrelated-main drift is therefore an execution-order starvation defect. Config8 removes generic post-freeze head polling from the checker critical path and moves exact root/config identity verification to a fail-closed acceptance-publication barrier, preserving frozen semantics and CLEAN isolation while allowing bounded checker work to finish.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if config8 consumes newer-head semantics, emits positive Phase-1 acceptance after an actual/unverifiable root or evaluation-config change, executes checker-v2 before durable precommit/readback, crosses CLEAN isolation, or blocks authorized role-local checkpointing. Never relax checker-v2 hard gates, exact provenance, repository write boundaries, or the current 14-role Phase-1 denominator.
